caption: The drawing depicts a bust-length figure of a mannequin dressed in a military uniform. The mannequin is wearing a yellowish-brown jacket with blue cuffs and blue details on the shoulder straps and pocket flaps. The figure has a blue high-collar underneath the jacket. Two brown leather straps cross diagonally over the chest, likely for securing equipment. Around the waist, the figure has an ammunition belt with visible bullets or cartridges. On the left side of the mannequin, a rifle or long firearm is slung from the shoulder down across the body, and there is another leather strap or sling attached to this weapon. The head of the mannequin is colored in muted green and yellow tones, and it is topped with a brown wide-brimmed hat with a dark band. The background is blank and beige. The drawing is signed in the lower right by B. Krieger with a date of 3/6/36 and a note indicating "CITY MUSEUM 3RD FL."
title: Uniform
